description: At or below the threshold listed businesses simply add (Form 8995): K-1 income $100,000 with business 2 = $60,000 and business 3 = a −$10,000 rental loss (in qbiLossOffset and nonpassiveScheduleELoss). Total QBI $90,000, 20% = $18,000; taxable income $50,000 + $100,000 − $10,000 − $15,750 = $124,250, overall limit $24,850. No SSTB, W-2 wage or aggregation question is asked.
